title: BI analyst, data analyst, data engineer and data scientist: who does what

videos.script: Lívia's contract says BI analyst. In her first two months she wrote definitions, explored a drop in sales, and fixed a broken data pipeline on a Friday afternoon. {{three-jobs}} That is three jobs, and at a company of Varanda's size that is normal. This lesson separates them. {{four}} The data engineer delivers data that arrives correct and on time. The BI analyst delivers the same answer every week, with its definition written down. The data analyst answers a new question, once. The data scientist builds a model that predicts or decides. They are four kinds of work, not four steps on a ladder. {{renata}} Then one question travels through all four. Renata asks which customers will come back, and each role does a different part of the answer. {{adverts}} Then job titles, which drift, and how to read an advert by its verbs instead. {{handoff}} Last, the handoffs. A pipeline changes on the first of March, nobody tells the analyst, and a rate moves a full point with no customer behaving differently.
